Article 1 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in twelve languages
(the AI Lab's language comparison; the texts are inside site/assets/app.js, in UDHR).

Source: the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR),
Universal Declaration of Human Rights Translation Project:
https://www.ohchr.org/en/human-rights/universal-declaration/universal-declaration-human-rights/about-universal-declaration-human-rights-translation-project
OHCHR asks that reproductions refer to that page as the source.
Source text (c) 1996-2022 The Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights.

The plain-text versions come from the "UDHR in Unicode" collection compiled by the
Unicode Consortium (as distributed in the NLTK udhr2 corpus). The Unicode License applies:

Changes made here: all texts are normalized to Unicode NFC, and the Yoruba text uses today's
dot-below letters (ẹ, ọ, ṣ) in place of the older vertical-line marks.
